name: dspre-lua
description: Error checking, completion, hover, signature help, go to definition and formatting for the Lua scripts of a DSPRE project.

dspreLua.server.command.markdownDescription: Command that starts the language server, e.g. `["dotnet", "/path/to/dspre-lua-ls.dll"]`. The default needs `dspre-lua-ls` on the PATH.

dspreLua.server.databases.markdownDescription: Folder with DSPRE's built-in script command databases (`*_scrcmd_database.json`). Empty: the server looks next to itself and in DSPRE's data folder. A project's own database always wins.
